summary:
Implement Blockbench Model Integration & Advanced AI:
- [ ] Update `EntityData.java` with AI flags and model file field.
- [ ] Update `ModMakerApp.java` UI with model file picker and AI checkboxes.
- [ ] Update `ModGenerator.java` to process custom `.java` models from Blockbench.
- [ ] Implement dynamic `registerGoals` logic in `ModGenerator.java` based on AI flags.
- [ ] Implement specialized AI behaviors (pouncing, sun damage, water avoidance) in generated entity code.
- [ ] Verify functionality with a sample custom model.
